rules: Any PRE_RUNTIME hard-gate FAIL prevents formal save or status promotion.
Changed-pixel, ROI, alpha, bbox, centroid, registration and SHA checks are necessary but never sufficient for PASS.
Human anatomy continuity, linework continuity, and fixed-drum composite semantics are mandatory visual gates.
A frame that is locally pixel-correct but anatomically implausible, line-broken, or semantically contradictory is FAIL.
PRE_RUNTIME warnings may be non-blocking only when they do not overlap human anatomy, linework integrity, contact semantics, or composite coherence.
POST_RUNTIME visual QA must inspect actual app screenshots before/at/after the event and verify transition coherence.
VERIFIED / APPROVED_LIVE are forbidden while any mandatory visual-integrity gate is missing or failed.
